description.ja: DeepSeek AIの第2世代Vision-Language MoEモデル。2024年12月13日公開。384x384基本解像度で動的タイリング対応。Tiny（3.37B/1.0B活性化）、Small（16.1B/2.8B活性化）、フル（27.5B/4.5B活性化）の3サイズ展開。OCR、文書理解、チャート分析に強い。
description.en: DeepSeek AI's second-generation Vision-Language MoE model. Released December 13, 2024. Supports dynamic tiling from 384x384 base resolution. Available in Tiny (3.37B/1.0B active), Small (16.1B/2.8B active), and full (27.5B/4.5B active) sizes. Strong in OCR, document understanding, and chart analysis.

specs.architecture: Vision-Language MoE, 384x384 base resolution, Dynamic tiling

description.ja: 3.37B総パラメータ、1.0B活性化の軽量版。MMStar 45.9、OCRBench 809達成。
description.en: Lightweight with 3.37B total, 1.0B active parameters. Achieves 45.9 on MMStar and 809 on OCRBench.

description.ja: 16.1B総パラメータ、2.8B活性化の中型版。
description.en: Medium size with 16.1B total, 2.8B active parameters.

description.ja: 27.5B総パラメータ、4.5B活性化のフルサイズ版。
description.en: Full size with 27.5B total, 4.5B active parameters.
